responsibility: Declares the abstract base layer of the Rust HIR expression hierarchy. It introduces `Expr` as the common node type for all lowered expressions, owning outer attributes and `Analysis::NodeMapping`, classifying expressions by block-bearing and expression kind, and defining cloning, locus, and visitor contracts; it also provides the `ExprWithoutBlock` specialization and `PathExpr` base used by path-like expressions. This is the structural interface shared by all concrete expression nodes declared in `rust-hir-expr.h`.
